rachel.s: Heads-up: FinTrust procurement ran into a failure on Azure Marketplace when uploading their DocuSign ZIP bundle. Portal returned `attachment_hash_mismatch`. They say their workflow requires ZIP and won't change it. :grimacing:
emma.p: Sales got pingedthey need the PO accepted today or onboarding slips. Can ops/eng triage?
lena.eng: can you paste the exact error?
rachel.s: `422 Unprocessable Entity {"error":"attachment_hash_mismatch","expected":"a1b2...","got":"c3d4..."}`
chet.ops: quick lookup: we rolled libarchive normalizer 2026-02-18 which strips trailing nulls and normalizes filenames; that can change signed envelope bytes.
marketplace-bot: deploy 2026-02-18 libarchive update (rev c3f2b1)  note: filename normalization changed.
lena.eng: altering bytes is the culprit. Two options: 1) ask customer to upload individual PDFs (supported) or 2) implement per-tenant preserve mode that bypasses normalization and stores raw blob.
rachel.s: they'll refuse option 1. They want us to accept their zip.
anil.legal: If we accept raw signed blobs we need an explicit waiver and audit trail. Can't silently accept modified signatures. I'll draft minimal language.
chet.ops: ops concerns: raw ingestion increases blobstore costs and opens zip-bomb/DoS risks. We'll need quotas + depth/size scanning.
lena.eng: tech estimate: add header `X-RW-Preserve-Raw: true` to ingestion API to skip normalization. Implementation: 1 eng ~ 2 days (including zip-scan), plus canary routing changes ~4h.
sales-bot: Sales flagged: opportunity FT-2026-42 will delay without fix; revenue impact.
rachel.s: can we do a single-tenant canary if they sign waiver? timeline?
lena.eng: if legal ok with waiver and ops accepts quotas we can open PR today, deploy to staging tomorrow, and flip a prod canary in 24-36h.
anil.legal: draft waiver: "By electing raw-blob ingestion Customer acknowledges Redwood will store original uploaded artifacts without byte normalization for the purpose of PO acceptance; Customer remains responsible for signature verification and indemnifies Redwood for disputes arising from signature validation." I'll DM the exact wording.
chet.ops: ops will prepare feature-flag path and zip-scan policy; need to know tenant ID to scope.
rachel.s: I'm on call with FinTrust now. I'll request signed ACK and tenant scoping. ETA 30m.
marketplace-bot: Created ticket MP-7010 "preserve-raw-blob-for-fintrust" assigned to @lena.eng.
emma.p: thanks team. Once we have signed ACK we'll coordinate canary flip and monitor ingestion logs. :thumbsup:
